data.name: Harjeet
data.gender_notes: Harjeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Har is a Hindu god, Jeet means victory. The name Harjeet symbolizes the triumph of the god Har over the evil forces, implying strength, courage, and victory. The name Harjeet carries the meaning “God's Victor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with divine origins, inspiring faith and determination.
data.etymology: Harjeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Victor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harjeet total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
